_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

agreement.claim: both engines report the same mean change, interval, SD of the change and t statistic
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 at ten decimals on every key. harness/comparisons_examples.test.py also rebuilds the interval from the differences and shows the unpaired Welch interval on the same columns is 4.2 times wider.

recovery.claim: the mean change and its SD are close to the values the fixture was built with

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: Measured by harness/comparisons_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 of this generator.
